faqs.question: What is the pricing of WhatsApp Business API in the Philippines?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API pricing in the Philippines includes messaging charges and a platform subscription. MSG91 offers messaging rates approximately 10% lower than Meta's standard GBP pricing, helping businesses reduce communication expenses.
  • MSG91's rates for Philippine numbers (+63), in GBP, are:
    • Marketing: £0.05488 per message
    • Utility: £0.00736 per message
    • Authentication: £0.00736 per message
    • Service: £0.00736 per billable message after the free allowance
  • The MSG91 Titan plan costs £6/month, with the first two months free. Messaging charges and applicable taxes are separate.
  • For example, sending 10,000 billable marketing messages costs £548.80 with MSG91 compared with £607 at Meta's standard rate, saving £58.20 before subscription fees and taxes.
  • For a detailed breakdown, explore MSG91 WhatsApp Business API Pricing in the Philippines and Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Pricing.

faqs.question: How can businesses in the Philippines reduce WhatsApp support costs after Meta's October 2026 pricing changes?
faqs.answer:
• Since October 1, 2026, Meta has charged for WhatsApp service messages beyond the monthly free allowance. The first 1,000 service messages per business phone number remain free each month, while additional billable messages cost £0.00736 each with MSG91 in the Philippines.
  • Utility templates sent within an active customer service window also became chargeable, subject to applicable exceptions.
  • For businesses handling hundreds of customer enquiries daily, these costs can add up.
  • MSG91 Chat Window helps reduce expenses through a simple process: WhatsApp → Chat Window → Hello.
  • Customers start on WhatsApp and continue conversations through a dedicated Chat Window. AI chatbots and human agents can then assist through Hello without sending every reply over WhatsApp.
  • Messages exchanged inside Chat Window don't incur Meta's WhatsApp messaging charges. Messages sent through WhatsApp remain chargeable.
  • Follow the MSG91 Chat Window setup guide.

faqs.question: WhatsApp Cloud API Setup Without Developers: How easy is it to get started with MSG91 in the Philippines?
faqs.answer:
• Getting started with WhatsApp automation shouldn't require coding skills. MSG91 makes WhatsApp Cloud API setup simple, even for business owners and teams without technical experience.
  • You can connect your WhatsApp number, launch campaigns, create approved message templates, and configure supported chatbots through a user-friendly dashboard.
  • Get started in four steps:
    • 1: Create your MSG91 account.
    • 2: Connect your Meta Business Portfolio.
    • 3: Add an eligible number.
    • 4: Complete verification and configure your messages.
  • That's it! Once connected, you can start managing everyday WhatsApp communication without writing code. Advanced custom integrations may require technical configuration, and additional Meta verification can affect activation time.
  • Do I need DTI or SEC registration, and can I keep my +63 number? DTI registration for sole proprietorships or SEC documents for corporations may be requested during Meta business verification, but they aren't mandatory for every initial setup.
  • Already using WhatsApp Business on your +63 number? You may be able to migrate an eligible number to MSG91. However, WhatsApp Coexistence isn't currently supported for Philippine numbers, so simultaneous use of the Business App and API on the same number isn't available through that feature.
  • Need help? MSG91 offers 24/7 customer assistance, combining expert human support through email, WhatsApp, calls, and scheduled Google Meet sessions with round-the-clock AI that handles both routine questions and complex technical enquiries.
  • Human expertise when you need it. Intelligent AI whenever you need answers.

  • From your first WhatsApp setup to everyday customer communication, MSG91 keeps your business connected and supported.
